build_list_pipelines: list available pipelines from configured OpenAI API backend instances
upload_pipeline_file: upload a Python pipeline .py file to a configured OpenAI API backend
add_pipeline_url: add a new pipeline by providing its remote URL and backend index
delete_pipeline: delete a pipeline from a configured OpenAI API backend by its ID
update_pipeline_valves: update configuration valves for a specific pipeline on a backend
